text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was notified that due to heavy rain, training
would be held indoors, and headed toward the training gym, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, in this rain, it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's really coming down out there.
The turf is going to be muddy for a while...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, didn't we just plant
pansies in the plaza's flowerbed...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If this continues, the seeds will go bad...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't just stand by. I must cover and protect it with a sheet...!

Afterward, we managed to cover the flowerbeds with tarps,
but couldn't make it in time for training,
and ended up neglecting our practice...
